stem:
The table shows the ratio of people who ate a certain type of lunch to the total number of people who ate lunch.

A total of 840 people ate lunch. Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Half as many people ate a turkey sandwich as ate a vegetarian sandwich.

options.label: B
options.text: One-fourth as many people ate a vegetarian sandwich as ate a salad.

options.label: C
options.text: There were 56 more people who ate a turkey sandwich than ate a chicken sandwich.

options.label: D
options.text: There were 28 more people who ate a salad than ate a chicken sandwich.

visual_elements: Table with header 'Lunch' and two columns labeled 'Type of Lunch' and 'Ratio to the Total'. Rows: 'Turkey sandwich' with ratio 1/3, 'Vegetarian sandwich' with ratio 1/6, 'Chicken sandwich' with ratio 4/15, and 'Salad' with ratio 7/30.
